observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission gearbox on paving blocks with a torque converter beside it; a white label shows “460” and a watermark reads “FIDEL AUTOS GLOBAL LIMITED”.
Photo 1 is a close-up of the torque converter and bell housing with the same watermark.
Photo 2 shows the gearbox from another angle with the bell housing and torque converter visible; no readable model plate is clear.

claims.claim: Transmissions Gearbox M278 1282 OEM G63, Mercedes transmission gearbox
claims.evidence: No M278, 1282, or G63 marking is readable in any photo; seller text alone is not proof.
Photos show only the exterior; no operation or test is shown.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not work internally despite appearing intact externally
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox shifting through gears or a bench test

risks.risk: It may not be a Mercedes M278/G63 gearbox as claimed
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the manufacturer identification plate
risks.if_unproven: as an unidentified generic automatic gearbox

risks.risk: Internal wear or damage cannot be seen from the outside
risks.proof: Photos of the inside after removing the oil pan or a mechanic's inspection report
risks.if_unproven: as used with unknown internal condition

proof_requests: Clear photo of the identification plate showing the part number
Video of the gearbox being operated or shifted
Photo of the gearbox interior or oil pan condition
response.reason: The photos show an automatic transmission gearbox with torque converter, so it can be priced at its worst case as an unverified used gearbox; the claimed M278 identity and working condition are unproven.
